## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Format** | Standard |
| **Colors** | White / Blue / Red / Green |
| **Archetype** | Combo-midrange (tap-engine) |
| **Size** | 60 cards (37 nonland / 23 lands) |
| **Primary win** | Saddled Mount stampede with doubled damage |
| **Secondary win** | Death to Our Enemies burn + card-advantage grind |

## Overview

The Rewritten Stampede fuses three mechanics into one engine: **Saddle** mounts
attack for value, **Convoke** spells are cast by tapping the same creatures, and
**Plan** enchantments count every tap. The heart of the deck is **Rewrite
History**: whenever one or more creatures you control become tapped, you draw a
card, discard a card, and advance the plan. Attacking, saddling, convoking, and
even Station all tap creatures — so every axis of the deck draws cards.

The other two Plans turn the same actions into resources. **Death to Our
Enemies** makes a Treasure for every noncreature spell you cast (all your
Convoke spells), which ramps the deck into its 5-6 mana finishers, and caps at
7 damage. **Political Triumph** turns every creature that enters into scry 1
plus a plan counter, ending in a global +1/+1 anthem.

The payoff is a go-wide Mount army. **Seraphic Steed** mints 3/3 flying Angels
each saddled attack, **Bridled Bighorn** adds Sheep, **Bounding Felidar** pumps
the whole team, **Drover Grizzly** gives trample, and **Collective Inferno**
doubles all damage dealt by Mounts. **Dracosaur Auxiliary** swings in the air
with haste and shocks anything. Games end in one massive, doubled, trampling
stampede — or a 7-point burn finish.

## Approach

### Game plan phases

1. **Setup (T1-3):** Play **Political Triumph** or a cheap Mount (**Gilded
   Ghoda**, **Seraphic Steed**). Untap the Roads lands with a Mount in play and
   land **Rewrite History**.
2. **Engine (T3-5):** Resolve **Rewrite History** and **Death to Our Enemies**.
   Every saddle tap draws a card; every Convoke spell makes a Treasure. Mounts
   attack while saddled to generate tokens and Treasures.
3. **Stampede (T5-7):** Slam **Collective Inferno** (choose Mount), saddle
   **Dracosaur Auxiliary** / **Bounding Felidar** / **Guardian Sunmare** with
   Pilots and tokens, and attack for doubled, trampling, lifelink damage.
4. **Cleanup:** Burn with **Death to Our Enemies** (7 split), or bury the
   opponent in cards with **Harmonized Crescendo** (draw per Mount) and
   **Rewrite History** recursion.

### Card roles

| Role | Cards |
|---|---|
| Tap-draw engine | Rewrite History |
| Treasure ramp / burn | Death to Our Enemies |
| Anthem plan | Political Triumph |
| Token Mounts | Seraphic Steed, Bridled Bighorn |
| Mana Mount | Gilded Ghoda |
| Finisher Mounts | Dracosaur Auxiliary, Bounding Felidar |
| Engine Mounts | Guardian Sunmare (tutor), Unswerving Sloth (untap all), Drover Grizzly (trample) |
| Convoke interaction | Temporal Cleansing, Appeal to Eirdu, The Wandering Rescuer |
| Convoke draw | Unexpected Assistance, Harmonized Crescendo |
| Damage doubler | Collective Inferno |

### Lands as engines

| Land | Role |
|---|---|
| Rocky Roads / Reef Roads | Make 1/1 Pilot tokens that saddle Mounts as though their power were 2 greater; untap with a Mount in play |
| Bucolic Ranch | Mount-colored mana; digs for finisher Mounts |
| Adagia, Windswept Bastion | Station: tap spare creatures (each tap draws via Rewrite History) for charge counters; at 12+, copy Collective Inferno or a Plan |
| Starting Town / Gathering Place | Early any-color fixing |

### Curve and mana

Average nonland CMC is 3.5. The curve peaks at 3-5; the two 6-drops
(**Dracosaur Auxiliary**, **Harmonized Crescendo**) are effectively cheaper
thanks to Convoke, Treasures, and Bucolic Ranch. The deck runs 23 lands but
plays like 26: Treasures from Gilded Ghoda and Death to Our Enemies, plus
creature-tapping for Convoke, generate the extra mana.

## Gameplay strategy

### Early game

Mulligan for **Rewrite History** plus any 1-2 drop Mount or **Political
Triumph**. A turn-1 Political Triumph followed by creatures scries every draw
step. Gilded Ghoda is the best early Mount: 2/2, saddle 1, and every saddled
attack makes a Treasure — ramp and card draw on one body. Seraphic Steed (2/2
first strike, lifelink) races aggro while it waits for saddle 4.

### Mid game

Land **Death to Our Enemies** and start casting Convoke spells — each one makes
a Treasure. **Unswerving Sloth** is the engine-breaker: saddle it (tap 4 power),
attack, and it untaps every creature you control, setting up a free main-phase
Convoke turn. **Guardian Sunmare** tutors any nonland permanent with mana value
3 or less on a saddled attack — fetch a second copy of a Plan, another Mount,
or a Convoke spell.

### The combo turn

1. Have a wide board of Mounts and at least **Collective Inferno** (Mount).
2. Main phase 1: tap Pilots and tokens to saddle **Dracosaur Auxiliary**
   (saddle 3), **Bounding Felidar** (saddle 2) and **Guardian Sunmare**
   (saddle 4). Every tap draws a card off Rewrite History and every noncreature
   spell cast so far made a Treasure.
3. Attack: Dracosaur flies over for 4 (8 with Inferno) plus 2-4 shock damage;
   Felidar puts a +1/+1 counter on every other creature and gains life;
   Drover Grizzly grants trample; Seraphic Steed mints 3/3 Angels; lifelink
   keeps you ahead.
4. Main phase 2: **Harmonized Crescendo** (choose Mount) draws a card per Mount
   permanent — routinely 8-12 cards — or **Unexpected Assistance** digs deeper.
   **Rewrite History** then returns the best instants/sorceries from the
   graveyard to hand for the next loop.

A fully developed board deals 25-40 doubled, trampling damage in one swing.

### Win condition 2: burn and grind

**Death to Our Enemies** reaches four plan counters after four noncreature
spells (Plans, Convoke spells, and lands' activated abilities do not count —
spells only). That is easy with this shell: the payoff is 7 damage split as you
choose, usually 7 to the face to finish after one stampede. In grindy games,
**Rewrite History** recurs Temporal Cleansing, Appeal to Eirdu, and Unexpected
Assistance, while Harmonized Crescendo refills the hand off the Mount count.

### Mulligan guide

Keep: any hand with Rewrite History or Political Triumph plus 2-3 lands and a
creature. Keep 2-land hands only with a 1-2 drop Mount (Gilded Ghoda, Seraphic
Steed). Ship: hands without a Mount or a Plan, and hands flooded with 5-6 mana
spells. Bucolic Ranch is a strong keep — it fixes and finds the finishers.

### Key interactions and edge cases

- **Rewrite History triggers on any tap**: attacking, saddling, convoking, and
  Station taps all draw. Plan the order — saddle first, then convoke, so each
  tap draws.
- **Pilots saddle as power 3**: one Pilot covers saddle 1-3; two Pilots cover
  saddle 4 (Seraphic Steed, Guardian Sunmare, Unswerving Sloth).
- **The Wandering Rescuer** protects tapped creatures with hexproof and blocks
  with flash, double strike — cast it with Convoke at instant speed.
- **Temporal Cleansing** answers anything nonland, including indestructible
  threats (it tucks instead of destroying).
- **Adagia** copies an enchantment at 12+ charge counters: copying Collective
  Inferno quadruples Mount damage; copying a Plan re-runs its payoff.
- **Death to Our Enemies** cares about spells, not abilities: saddling and
  Station do not advance it, Convoke spells and Plans do.

### Matchups

- **Aggro:** Seraphic Steed's lifelink, The Wandering Rescuer's flash blocks,
  and Bounding Felidar's lifegain stabilize; stall until the stampede.
- **Control:** Death to Our Enemies ramps you through counterspells (Treasures
  are instant-speed mana), Rewrite History restocks after board wipes, and
  hexproof from The Wandering Rescuer protects tapped attackers.
- **Midrange:** out-muscle with Angels, trample, and doubled damage; Temporal
  Cleansing removes the single biggest blocker.
